1.web: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
1.asv: My son, forget not my law; But let thy heart keep my commandments:

2.web: for length of days, and years of life, and peace, will they add to you.
2.asv: For length of days, and years of life, And peace, will they add to thee.

3.web: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
3.asv: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee: Bind them about thy neck; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart:

4.web: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
4.asv: So shalt thou find favor and good understanding In the sight of God and man.

5.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
5.asv: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding:

6.web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
6.asv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he will direct thy paths.

7.web: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
7.asv: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:

8.web: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
8.asv: It will be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.

9.web: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
9.asv: Honor Jehovah with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase:

10.web: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
10.asv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy vats shall overflow with new wine.

11.web: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his reproof:
11.asv: My son, despise not the chastening of Jehovah; Neither be weary of his reproof:

12.web: for whom Yahweh loves, he reproves; even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
12.asv: For whom Jehovah loveth he reproveth, Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

13.web: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
13.asv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that getteth understanding.

14.web: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
14.asv: For the gaining of it is better than the gaining of silver, And the profit thereof than fine gold.

15.web: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
15.asv: She is more precious than rubies: And none of the things thou canst desire are to be compared unto her.

16.web: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
16.asv: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honor.

17.web: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
17.asv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.

18.web: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
18.asv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: And happy is every one that retaineth her.

19.web: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
19.asv: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding he established the heavens.

20.web: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
20.asv: By his knowledge the depths were broken up, And the skies drop down the dew.

21.web: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
21.asv: My son, let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep sound wisdom and discretion:

22.web: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
22.asv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.

23.web: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
23.asv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thy foot shall not stumble.

24.web: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
24.asv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

25.web: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes:
25.asv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, Neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh:

26.web: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
26.asv: For Jehovah will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being taken.

27.web: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
27.asv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.

28.web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
28.asv: Say not unto thy neighbor, Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give; When thou hast it by thee.

29.web: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
29.asv: Devise not evil against thy neighbor, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

30.web: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
30.asv: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.

31.web: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
31.asv: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.

32.web: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
32.asv: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; But his friendship is with the upright.

33.web: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
33.asv: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; But he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.

34.web: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
34.asv: Surely he scoffeth at the scoffers; But he giveth grace unto the lowly.

35.web: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
35.asv: The wise shall inherit glory; But shame shall be the promotion of fools.
